Furthermore, the recent increase in capital expenditures (CWIP) of 33.3% from the previous year [E40] suggests that the company is actively investing to support future growth. Given these factors, Shree Ganesh Remedies Ltd appears to be underappreciated by the market and offers a compelling investment opportunity with strong earnings potential and positive tailwinds in its sector.
